Montana Code Annotated 2025


      TITLE 45
subsections: CRIMES CHAPTER 5. OFFENSES AGAINST THE PERSON Part 1. Homicide Inference Of Mental State 45-5-112. Inference of mental state. In a deliberate homicide, knowledge or purpose may be inferred from the fact that the accused committed a homicide and no circumstances of mitigation, excuse, or justification appear.
